sources.snippet: Methods We trained this model using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), using the same methods as InstructGPT ⁠, but with slight differences in the data collection setup. We trained an initial model using supervised fine-tuning: human AI trainers provided conversations in which they played both sides—the user and an AI assistant.
